title: A Phased Workflow for Operating LLM-Based Coding Agents
abstract: arXiv:2608.30701v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: LLM-based coding agents combine a foundation model with a harness that shapes agent behavior. For non-trivial tasks, how practitioners structure their work with the coding agents determines whether reliable results follow. We report on a phased workflow for operating coding agents developed by the AI research team at Infobip. The workflow structures agent-assisted development into four phases where human effort is front-loaded and delegation increases as artifacts mature. Context management is the central concern, addressed through four strategies applied at each phase to counter known failure modes. From practitioner experience, we observe that upstream errors in research and planning can compound across later phases, while correcting generated code can introduce bloat and fragility. translated_title: 一种用于操作基于大语言模型编码智能体的分阶段工作流
translated_abstract: 基于大语言模型（LLM）的编码智能体将基础模型与塑造智能体行为的工具框架相结合。对于非平凡的任务，实践者如何构建与编码智能体协作的工作方式，决定了能否获得可靠的结果。我们报告了由 Infobip 公司 AI 研究团队开发的、用于操作编码智能体的分阶段工作流。该工作流将智能体辅助的开发过程划分为四个阶段，其中人工投入被前置，而随着产物的成熟，对智能体的委托程度逐渐增加。上下文管理是核心关注点，通过在每个阶段应用四种策略来应对已知的失败模式。从实践者的经验来看，我们观察到研究和规划阶段的上游错误会在后续阶段中不断累积放大，而对生成代码的修正可能引入臃肿和脆弱性。这促使我们将人工审查前置。我们识别出两个开放问题：缺乏衡量工作流有效性的指标，以及形式化……（原文摘要至此截断）
tldr: 本文提出由 Infobip AI 团队开发的四阶段分阶段工作流来操作基于 LLM 的编码智能体，通过前置人工投入与上下文管理策略应对已知失败模式，从而提升智能体辅助开发的可靠性。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a four-phase workflow developed by Infobip's AI research team for operating LLM-based coding agents, which improves reliability by front-loading human effort and applying context management strategies to counter known failure modes.
